svg.text: A MEASURE · HOW OFTEN DOES QUANTIZATION BREAK AN ANSWER?
Same GSM8K items in two formats separate
All quantized tiers loaded with bitsandbytes;
100 prompts per task, checked before the full run
FP16 runs with different batch order
Only FP16-correct prompts are kept, so
y = 1 means quantization broke the answer,
not that the prompt was simply hard.
B LEARN · PREDICT FRAGILITY FROM THE PROMPT
KL / JS divergence, FP16 vs quantized
One router per precision + one pooled
The router must beat shortcuts, not just chance
C DEPLOY · PRECISION ROUTER ON THE EDGE DEVICE
τ is set by the escalation budget, e.g. escalate the riskiest 15% of prompts
